## 📐 Phase 4 — Grammar Teaching: Two-case prepositions (Wo? vs Wohin?)

This is the main grammar of Lektion 11 — **describing where things ARE located**!

---

### 📖 The Rule

German has prepositions that take **TWO different cases** depending on meaning:

| Question | Meaning | Case |
|---|---|---|
| **Wo?** | Where is it? (location) | **Dativ** |
| **Wohin?** | Where is it going? (movement) | **Akkusativ** |

### The 9 two-case prepositions:
**an, auf, hinter, in, neben, über, unter, vor, zwischen**

---

### 📊 Article changes:

| | **der** (m) | **die** (f) | **das** (n) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Dativ (Wo?)** | **dem** | **der** | **dem** |
| **Akkusativ (Wohin?)** | **den** | **die** | **das** |

---

### 🔑 Reusable Sentence Patterns:

**Pattern 1 — Location (Wo? → Dativ):**
"___ liegt/steht/ist auf dem/der/dem [ORT]"
- "Der Tacker liegt **auf dem** Tisch." (der Tisch)
- "Die Maus liegt **neben der** Tastatur." (die Tastatur)
- "Das Post-It klebt **an dem** Bildschirm." (an dem = **am**)

**Pattern 2 — Movement (Wohin? → Akkusativ):**
"Ich lege/stelle/hänge ___ auf den/die/das [ORT]"
- "Ich lege den Tacker **auf den** Tisch."
- "Ich stelle die Maus **neben die** Tastatur."
- "Ich hänge das Post-It **an den** Bildschirm."

---

### 💡 Key contractions:
| Long form | Short form |
|---|---|
| in + dem | **im** |
| an + dem | **am** |
| in + das | **ins** |
| an + das | **ans** |

---

### 🔑 Key verbs to remember:
| Verb | Use |
|---|---|
| **liegen** | something lies flat (Wo?) |
| **stehen** | something stands upright (Wo?) |
| **hängen** | something hangs (Wo?) |
| **legen** | to place flat (Wohin?) |
| **stellen** | to place upright (Wohin?) |
| **hängen** | to hang something (Wohin?) |

## 📐 Phase 4 — GRAMMAR TEACHING: Two-case prepositions

### The Big Idea

These 9 prepositions can take **two different cases** depending on whether you're describing **location** or **direction/movement**:

**an, auf, hinter, in, neben, über, unter, vor, zwischen**

The key question to ask yourself every time:

| Question | Meaning | Case |
|---|---|---|
| **Wo?** | Where IS it? (static location) | **Dativ** |
| **Wohin?** | Where is it GOING? (movement/placement) | **Akkusativ** |

---

### 📊 Full Article Table

| | **der** (m) | **die** (f) | **das** (n) | **die** (pl) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Akkusativ (Wohin?)** | **den/einen** | **die/eine** | **das/ein** | **die/-** |
| **Dativ (Wo?)** | **dem/einem** | **der/einer** | **dem/einem** | **den/-** |

---

### 💡 Key Contractions — memorize these!

| Long form | Short form |
|---|---|
| in + dem | **im** |
| an + dem | **am** |
| in + das | **ins** |
| an + das | **ans** |

---

### 🔑 The Three Location Verbs (Wo? → Dativ)

From the lesson tips — this is CRITICAL:

| Verb | When to use | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **liegen** | object lies flat | Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch |
| **stehen** | object stands upright | Der Ordner steht im Regal |
| **hängen** | object hangs on wall | Das Bild hängt an der Wand |

### 🔑 The Three Placement Verbs (Wohin? → Akkusativ)

| Verb | When to use | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **legen** | placing flat | Ich lege den Zettel auf den Tisch |
| **stellen** | placing upright | Ich stelle den Ordner ins Regal |
| **hängen** | hanging something | Ich hänge das Bild an die Wand |

---

### 🔑 3 Reusable Sentence Patterns

**Pattern 1 — Where IS something? (Wo? → Dativ):**
"[DING] liegt/steht/hängt + [PREPOSITION] + dem/der/dem [ORT]"
- "Der Tacker liegt **auf dem** Tisch." (der Tisch)
- "Die Maus liegt **neben der** Tastatur." (die Tastatur)
- "Das Buch steht **im** Regal." (in + dem = im)

**Pattern 2 — Where are you PUTTING something? (Wohin? → Akkusativ):**
"Ich lege/stelle/hänge + [DING] + [PREPOSITION] + den/die/das [ORT]"
- "Ich lege den Zettel **auf den** Tisch." (der Tisch)
- "Ich stelle das Buch **ins** Regal." (in + das = ins)
- "Ich hänge das Bild **an die** Wand." (die Wand)

**Pattern 3 — Mixed description (office/room context):**
"[DING] ist/steht/liegt + [PREPOSITION] + [ORT], und ich lege/stelle [DING2] + [PREPOSITION] + [ORT2]"
- "Der Drucker steht **neben dem** Bildschirm, und ich lege das Post-It **auf den** Tacker."

---

### ⚠️ Common Mistakes & Traps

**Trap 1 — "hängen" exists for BOTH location and placement:**
- "Das Bild **hängt** an der Wand." (Wo? → Dativ) ✅
- "Ich **hänge** das Bild an die Wand." (Wohin? → Akkusativ) ✅
Same verb, different cases!

**Trap 2 — Feminine dative is "der" not "die":**
- "Die Tastatur" → neben **der** Tastatur (Dativ!) — this is where your case errors are coming from! 👀

**Trap 3 — Don't forget contractions:**
- "in dem Schrank" ❌ → **im Schrank** ✅
- "in das Regal" ❌ → **ins Regal** ✅

---

### 🔗 Connection to what you already know

You already know **mit + Dativ** from Lektion 10. Now you're adding location prepositions that ALSO use Dativ — when answering Wo? The logic is the same: Dativ = no movement, static situation.

## 🗺️ The 9 Two-Case Prepositions — Complete Guide

### 1. **an** — at / on (vertical surfaces)
Used for things touching a **vertical surface** (walls, doors, screens)
- "Das Bild hängt **an der** Wand." — The picture hangs **on the** wall.
- "Ich hänge das Post-It **an den** Bildschirm." — I hang the post-it **on the** monitor.
- Think: **an** = against a vertical surface 📌

---

### 2. **auf** — on (horizontal surfaces)
Used for things sitting **on top** of a surface
- "Der Tacker liegt **auf dem** Tisch." — The stapler lies **on the** table.
- "Ich lege den Brief **auf den** Schreibtisch." — I put the letter **on the** desk.
- Think: **auf** = flat surface on top 📄

---

### 3. **hinter** — behind
- "Der Drucker steht **hinter dem** Bildschirm." — The printer stands **behind the** monitor.
- "Ich stelle den Drucker **hinter den** Tisch." — I put the printer **behind the** table.
- Think: **hinter** = hidden behind something 👀

---

### 4. **in** — in / inside
Used for things **inside** something (drawers, rooms, buildings)
- "Das Papier ist **im** Schrank." — The paper is **in the** cupboard. *(in + dem = im)*
- "Ich lege das Buch **ins** Regal." — I put the book **into the** shelf. *(in + das = ins)*
- Think: **in** = inside/enclosed 📦

---

### 5. **neben** — next to / beside
- "Die Maus liegt **neben der** Tastatur." — The mouse is **next to the** keyboard.
- "Ich stelle den Kaffee **neben den** Computer." — I put the coffee **next to the** computer.
- Think: **neben** = side by side 👫

---

### 6. **über** — over / above
Used for things **floating above** without touching
- "Die Lampe hängt **über dem** Tisch." — The lamp hangs **above the** table.
- "Ich hänge die Lampe **über den** Tisch." — I hang the lamp **above the** table.
- Think: **über** = hovering above ☁️

---

### 7. **unter** — under / below
- "Der Locher liegt **unter dem** Tisch." — The hole punch is **under the** table.
- "Ich lege den Locher **unter den** Tisch." — I put the hole punch **under the** table.
- Think: **unter** = underneath 🐢

---

### 8. **vor** — in front of
- "Der Stuhl steht **vor dem** Schreibtisch." — The chair stands **in front of the** desk.
- "Ich stelle den Stuhl **vor den** Schreibtisch." — I put the chair **in front of the** desk.
- Think: **vor** = facing something 🚪

---

### 9. **zwischen** — between
- "Der Locher liegt **zwischen dem** Tacker und dem Stempel." — The hole punch is **between the** stapler and the stamp.
- "Ich lege den Locher **zwischen den** Tacker und den Stempel." — I put the hole punch **between the** stapler and the stamp.
- Think: **zwischen** = sandwiched between two things 🥪

---

## 📊 Quick Reference Card

| Preposition | Meaning | Picture |
|---|---|---|
| **an** | at/on (vertical) | 📌 |
| **auf** | on (horizontal) | 📄 |
| **hinter** | behind | 👀 |
| **in** | in/inside | 📦 |
| **neben** | next to | 👫 |
| **über** | above/over | ☁️ |
| **unter** | under/below | 🐢 |
| **vor** | in front of | 🚪 |
| **zwischen** | between | 🥪 |

---

## ⚡ The Golden Rule — always ask yourself:

**Wo? (Where is it?) → Dativ** — something is STAYING somewhere
**Wohin? (Where is it going?) → Akkusativ** — something is MOVING somewhere
